board.name: The Militarist

rules.name: Botnet Recruiters
rules.text: In the compute step, each Botnet with no player Ambassador on it puts 1 Agent on the city, research station or factory next to it holding the most Agents (else on its own site), and its compute with it.

effects.note: 275 (Matt, 2026-11-18): botnets seed an agent next to themselves a round; it replaced Garrisons' agent income

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each round, a military base with an adversary Troop on or next to it makes 1 extra Drone, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base in each production, whatever makes it.

rules.name: War Takes Ground
rules.text: When a Drone destroys a factory, it also destroys a Node on that hex.

effects.note: r83 (Matt, 2026-11-11, #52 follow-up): node loss as this adversary's own axis; a protection on the node still applies

difficulty.text: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.
flags: 151: unchanged but for the words (Deploy, board)
267: level 2's named rule, War Footing; its Muster +1 is cut (no mid-game arithmetic)

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered strike feeds the war machine.
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.
levels.rule: When Weapons Program fires, it musters 3, not 2.

research.name: Weapons Program
research.text: When the research track reaches its threshold, spend it: Muster 2: each country, 2 Troops on its lowest-numbered factory (else city).

effects.why: 259 (Matt, 2026-11-16): the Militarist's research becomes arms; troops fit its war axis (staging default 4)

research.value: 259: 2 troops a country (troops -7, 4 at 2 countries, 28) a fire; 3 from research_strong_at (Arms Race, d3): 42 at 2 countries. Over research_at 5 a country at d0 (10 at 2), a cube is 2.8; 4 a country from d1 (267): 3.5, 5.3 at d3-d4.

board.value: Botnet Recruiters: each botnet with no player ambassador on it seeds 1 agent a round (values.json infiltrate's per-agent 1.333; about 1-2 botnets a country, 1.3-2.7 a country a round), against one removal (5) or an ambassador on the botnet. Wall troops: 1 troop (9) a round where the Protector stands, against one removal (5): 1.8x. Warmongering: 1 extra corp troop a qualifying base a production step (4), against removing the adversary troop (5).
board.check: 275: Garrisons' agent income is gone with the pools; Botnet Recruiters seeds next to each botnet in the Income beat (`botnet_seed`), deterministically (the most agents, ties the lowest-numbered).
flags: 151: Garrisons replaces the board's creation line; build_bonus is gone (ambassador_income's d3 entry is the ladder's step)
275 (Matt, 2026-11-18): Garrisons (+1 agent income) became Botnet Recruiters (botnets seed 1 agent a round)
